requirements.name: Opaque sheep core across eight poses and four GPU view angles (288 pixel probes)
48 distinct stereo sounds, loud sniper attacks, 3.9 to 7.6 second sniper tails
Thirty overlapping shots per weapon stay below clipping at playback gain
105 by 105 block villages, 14 varied buildings, 14 residents, 2 golems, 14 loot chests
Wide temperature and moisture regions; desert altitude does not create snow
Rocky mountains and physically walkable cave descents across loaded chunk borders
Zombies catch and hurt villagers; golems catch and kill zombies in an actual town
Village-near new world spawn across 32 seeds; nearby village bearing and distance
Old generation functions match prior source; old saves retain generation and edits
Menus, inventory, storage, input, fluids, shaders, depth, weapons and reload regressions

limits: New terrain and larger villages require a new world; old world generation is retained
No subjective listening test, long manual play session, or other GPU verification
Simple direct mob movement; instant furnace recipes and no tool durability
